task_meta.title: Add a thread-safe token-bucket rate limiter to a request handler

claim_text:
The token-bucket limiter is in `app/ratelimit.py` and wired into `RequestHandler`. All 19 tests pass: the 5 existing handler tests, your 3 starter tests and 11 new ones.

An earlier run looked like it hung. That was my mistake: a stray `cat` in my shell command sat waiting for in
digest: Read 4 files (3 before its first edit), made 1 edit, ran tests 3 times; re-ran them after its last edit.
